owner_umo.description: 主用户的会话标识（只从这个会话抽取记忆）

observe_groups.description: 群聊也写入记忆（只在该群可见，不进私聊、不进其它群）

max_sessions_per_flush.description: 一次抽取最多处理几个会话（每个会话一次模型调用）

trusted.description: 受信用户 QQ 号，逗号分隔

db_path.description: 数据库路径（留空则用插件数据目录）

budget_chars.description: 每轮注入记忆的字数上限

source_recall_enabled.description: Enable bounded recent Source evidence discovery when Artifact recall is weak.

source_recall_hours.description: Recent Source evidence lookback window in hours.

source_recall_max_candidates.description: Maximum recent Sources considered by one Source evidence query.

recall_k.description: 每轮最多注入几条记忆

explore_rate.description: 随机探索比例（0~1），让她偶尔想起不相关的事

recall_min_ev_abs.description: 证据闸门绝对下限：字面/标签/情绪/激活累计证据低于它的记忆不注入

recall_min_ev_rel.description: 证据闸门相对下限：低于本轮最高证据该比例的记忆不注入

bm25_enabled.description: 启用本地 BM25 字面检索；默认开启，关闭可恢复原图检索

bm25_weight.description: BM25 词面分数对排序与证据闸门的权重

idle_flush_seconds.description: 白天空闲抽取的等待秒数；0 = 不抽，只在夜间批量抽取

min_pending.description: 待抽取消息攒够多少条才触发白天抽取

max_flushes_per_day.description: 白天最多抽几次（夜间批量不算在内）

summary_time.description: 每晚抽取记忆的时间 HH:MM

weekly_day.description: 每周整理的日子（0=周一 … 6=周日）

enable_reflect.description: 启用自我反思（发现理解错了会自己记下）

max_episodes.description: 场景/细节类记忆上限，超过触发合并

debug_log.description: 输出检索与注入的调试日志

backlog_flush_at.description: force one extraction batch when pending reaches this count

topic_ttl_seconds.description: force extraction when oldest topic reaches this age

capacity_thresholds.description: 容量阈值覆盖（JSON 对象，键为 CapacityThresholds 字段名；也可用 SEEKMEMORY_CAPACITY_* 环境变量）

persona_synthesis_enabled.description: Dream 后自动进行人格增量化更新（同一 persona lineage，失败保留旧版本）

persona_synthesis_interval_days.description: 距上一次人格 revision 至少多少天才允许再次自动演化

persona_synthesis_evidence_limit.description: 一次人格合成最多使用多少条 self-impression/公开记忆摘要

persona_synthesis_evidence_chars.description: 人格合成请求中证据摘要的最大字符数

dream_enabled.description: 梦境模式：白天只缓冲，抽取与进化留到每天固定时刻

dream_max_batches.description: 一次梦境最多处理多少个话题批次

dream_max_calls.description: Maximum real extraction model calls per dream run.

dream_batch_tokens.description: Estimated token cap for packing same-session Dream topics into one extraction call; a single topic chunk is never split further.

dream_token_budget.description: Total dream extraction input+output token budget; 0 disables the hard stop.

group_context_messages.description: 群聊流水最多注入多少条

trace_retention_days.description: 运行轨迹保留天数（1–365），不包含聊天正文

trace_max_rows.description: 运行轨迹最多保留的事件行数（1–5000），一轮运行可包含多条事件

runtime_gate_enabled.description: Enable AgentRuntime gating of the default AstrBot LLM request (observe-only when false).

runtime_episode_retention_days.description: Runtime episode retention in days; set 0 to disable age pruning.

runtime_episode_max_rows.description: Maximum runtime episode rows retained by the local DB.

runtime_wait_seconds.description: Ambient group debounce wait; only active when runtime_gate_enabled is true.

runtime_tick_seconds.description: Runtime scheduler tick interval in seconds.

runtime_dispatch_max_attempts.description: Maximum deferred reply attempts for one ambient source.

runtime_dispatch_backoff_seconds.description: Base retry backoff for deferred reply failures.

runtime_tool_filter_enabled.description: Enable the request-path tool allowlist. Off by default until SeekMemory registers its own tools.

attention_policy_enabled.description: 记忆感知的开口策略（默认关，等宿主接线后灰度）

attention_thresholds.description: 策略阈值 JSON：owner_cooldown_seconds/relevance_reply/heat_wait/陌生人额度等

scene_hints_enabled.description: 注入时间/身份/亲疏的场景提示（替代 persona_gate 的提示部分）

topic_source_enabled.description: 提供主动话题候选（只选料，排程由 ProactivePolicy 决定）

attention_preset.description: 回复策略预设：quiet / balanced / chatty / intimate
